kurz: Baked too long or stored open: the biscuits lose moisture, and the sugar in them sets hard.
bild_im_kopf: Like bread left out uncovered: the next day it is a brick.

ursachen.warum: Biscuits are thin. Even a minute too long drives out the last of the water.
fix: Take out when the edges have just set
Let them finish on the tray

ursachen.titel: Stored open or in a tin with dry biscuits
ursachen.warum: Soft biscuits give up moisture to the air or to dry neighbours.
fix: Put an apple slice in the tin

ursachen.titel: Too much flour when rolling out
ursachen.warum: Extra flour makes the dough drier and the biscuits harder.
fix: Roll out between two sheets of baking paper

q1.frage: Were the biscuits already hard straight out of the oven?

q2.frage: Were they stored open or in a tin with other kinds?
